description: This file defines the ShoppingCartSettings class and related functions for managing shopping cart configuration, validation, and retrieval within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: ShoppingCartSetupError
classes.description: Custom validation error class for shopping cart setup issues.

classes.name: ShoppingCartSettings
classes.description: Document class managing shopping cart configuration and validation.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads quotation series options into the shopping cart settings on load.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the shopping cart settings, including price list exchange rates.

methods.name: validate_price_list_exchange_rate
methods.description: Checks if exchange rate exists for the price list currency against the company's currency.

methods.name: validate_tax_rule
methods.description: Ensures a tax rule is set for the shopping cart.

methods.name: get_tax_master
methods.description: Retrieves the tax master based on billing territory.

methods.name: get_shipping_rules
methods.description: Retrieves shipping rules based on shipping territory.

methods.name: validate_cart_settings
methods.description: Validates the shopping cart settings document.

methods.name: get_shopping_cart_settings
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton shopping cart settings document.

methods.name: is_cart_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart is enabled.

methods.name: show_quantity_in_website
methods.description: Returns whether quantity should be shown on the website.

methods.name: check_shopping_cart_enabled
methods.description: Ensures the shopping cart is enabled, throws error if not.

methods.name: show_attachments
methods.description: Returns whether attachments are shown in the shopping cart.
